title: Cheese quiche
intro: Quiche is a French open tart from the Lorraine region of north-east France: a crisp, buttery pastry case holding a savoury custard of eggs, cream and milk that bakes until it is just set. The plain cheese version is the simplest and perhaps the most satisfying, with a silky filling, a golden, bubbly top and a sharp, savoury flavour from the melted cheese.
